transcript.content: I'm looking to do a discount campaign for my local taco shop. this should be sent to customers who are walking distance and within 15 min driving time. I want the mailer to feature product images, my logo, a QR code that allows me to track scans, and a small map that shows where I am located.

Love this — a taco shop discount mailer with a trackable QR code is a great combo. A couple things to nail down before I put together the first draft:\n\nFirst, what's the actual discount or offer you want to feature (like \"$2 off any combo\" or \"Buy One Get One Free\")? And when someone scans that QR code, where should it take them — your online menu, an ordering page, a coupon redemption screen?"
i want to offer a 15% OFF discount, and the QR code should take them to a redeemable coupon site where they can obtain the 15% OFF.

Perfect, that gives the mailer a clear call to action: scan for 15% off. Now let's nail down your business details so we can build out the map and contact info — what's your taco shop's name and address, and do you have a website or social handle you'd like included too?

https://tacodelmar.com/ Here's my website, the name is Taco Del Mar. address is 
725 Pike Street Suite #5
Seattle, WA 98101

Got it — Taco Del Mar at 725 Pike Street Suite #5, Seattle, WA 98101, with tacodelmar.com. That'll anchor the map and contact info nicely.\n\nLast couple pieces: do you want a phone number listed on the mailer for people to call, and what kind of feeling do you want this piece to give off — fun and vibrant, warm and inviting, bold and punchy? That'll help set the tone for the design and copy.
yes 3137012242. and vibrant, festive, fun for the mailer

Awesome — that's everything I need. Here's the shape of your campaign: a vibrant, festive, fun mailer for Taco Del Mar promoting 15% off, sent to residents within walking distance and a 15-minute drive of 725 Pike Street Suite #5, Seattle. It'll feature your logo, mouthwatering product images, a small location map, and a trackable QR code linking to a redeemable coupon page — plus your phone number, 313-701-2242, and website for good measure. I'll pull this together into a full campaign brief for you to review now.
